reconstruction: RECONSTRUCTED from the recorded trajectory because raw transcript_full.jsonl lines were not captured in the recordings. Row fields follow the A/B correspondence table of the research report (agy.md section 2.4): user text is the model-visible prompt (with the USER_REQUEST wrapper), tool results are the model-visible tool message text, planner rows carry response / thinking / tool_calls / token counts from the trajectory, CANCELED steps are dropped (the step_index hole), a step moved to the background keeps status RUNNING, created_at is the step's metadata.createdAt floored to the second. It is an approximation of the real file, not a copy of it.
sanitization: workspace path -> /work; ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain -> /work/brain; /Users/<name> -> /Users/user; local user name -> user; no account ids, tokens, userConfig, system prompts, workspace URIs or image bytes are kept; every field the parser reads is unchanged apart from those path substitutions. Non-ASCII text is stored as \uXXXX escapes.
scenario: s7+s8: schedule timer + nohup command in one planner row (two calls), timer fires and wakes the conversation, then /compact produces a CHECKPOINT
note: the CHECKPOINT content is the trajectory's checkpoint.sessionSummary truncated to 700 characters; the real row text of a checkpoint was not recorded
